definitions.explanation: dishes, pots, and utensils that need to be washed
clothes or items that need to be laundered

examples.japanese: {洗|あら}い{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洗|あら}い{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To do the dishes after eating.

examples.japanese: {洗|あら}い{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食洗機|しょくせんき}→食洗機：19300_shokusenki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せている→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧。
examples.english: I leave the dishes to the dishwasher.

examples.japanese: {洗|あら}い{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧だ。
examples.english: It's troublesome when there are a lot of dishes to wash.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ったら→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧{洗|あら}い{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱい⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When I got back from my trip, there was a lot of laundry.

examples.japanese: {洗|あら}い{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: I do the laundry all at once on weekends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧{洗|あら}い{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かない→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧。
examples.english: The laundry won't dry because it keeps raining.

notes:
SENSE 1 - DISHES:
- More commonly used for dishes
- {洗|あら}い{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do the dishes)
- {洗|あら}い{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溜|た}まる→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧ (dishes pile up)

SENSE 2 - LAUNDRY:
- Also used for laundry, though ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧ is more specific

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{皿洗|さらあら}い→皿洗い：13667_saraarai⟧ (dishwashing)
- ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧ (laundry - more specific)
- ⟦{食洗機|しょくせんき}→食洗機：19300_shokusenki⟧ (dishwasher)
